approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 XBLA version to native PC code using ReXGlue, based on saulob's PC port, with mouse aim and keyboard and mouse prompts
notes: Fork of saulob's port adding twin-stick mouse aim (shots go straight to the cursor), an animated crosshair, Escape to pause, keyboard prompts in every menu and a keyboard and mouse controls screen. Everything from the original port is kept.
